title: Weather and Seasons
goal: Students can talk about different types of weather and seasons.
goal_vi: Học sinh có thể nói về các loại thời tiết và mùa khác nhau.
cover_image_prompt: A wide, cheerful outdoor scene with diverse children playing happily in different weather conditions and seasons. One child is flying a kite in windy weather, another is building a small snowman, a group is under an umbrella in light rain, and two children are picking flowers in the sun. No text or letters.

patterns.pattern: In + season, it is + weather adjective.
patterns.vi: Vào mùa + [mùa], trời + [tính từ miêu tả thời tiết].

examples: There are four seasons in a year.
There are two main seasons in Vietnam.

patterns.vi: Tôi mặc + [quần áo] + vào mùa/thời tiết + [mùa/thời tiết].
examples: I wear a coat in winter.
I wear a hat when it is cold.

patterns.vi: Bạn có thích + mùa/thời tiết không?

grammar.title: It is + adjective (for weather)
grammar.explain_en: We use 'It is' to talk about the weather.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'It is' để nói về thời tiết.

grammar.title: I like + noun/gerund
grammar.explain_en: We use 'I like' to say what we enjoy.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'I like' để nói về điều mình thích.

grammar.title: Preposition 'In' for Seasons
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'in' trước các mùa trong năm.

grammar.title: What is the weather like?
grammar.explain_en: We use 'What is the weather like?' to ask about the weather.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'What is the weather like?' để hỏi về thời tiết.
examples: What is the weather like? It is sunny.
What is the weather like today? It is cloudy.

readings.title: Four Seasons
readings.text: There are four seasons in a year. They are spring, summer, autumn, and winter. In spring, it is warm. Many flowers bloom. In summer, it is hot. We can go swimming. In autumn, it is cool. Leaves fall from the trees. In winter, it is cold. Sometimes, it is snowy. I wear a warm coat. Which season do you like best?

readings.title: Weather Fun
readings.text: Hi, I am Ben. I like different kinds of weather. When it is sunny, I ride my bike. The sun is bright and warm. When it is rainy, I stay home. I read a book or play games with my sister. My umbrella is red. When it is cloudy, the sky is grey. It is not too hot. I can play outside with my dog. When it is windy, the trees move a lot. I fly my kite in the park. My kite is colorful. When it is snowy, I wear a hat and gloves. I make a snowman. I love playing in the snow! What do you do in different weather?

listening.script: Hello, children! Let's talk about the weather. Look outside! What is the weather like? Is it sunny or rainy? In Vietnam, we have two main seasons: the dry season and the rainy season. The dry season is usually sunny and hot. The rainy season has a lot of rain. In other countries, there are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. What is your favorite weather? What do you do on a rainy day? I like sunny days. I go to the park. What about you?

life_skill.title: APPRECIATE NATURE AND THE WEATHER
life_skill.intro: Nature gives us beautiful weather and seasons. Let's learn to appreciate them!
life_skill.intro_vi: Thiên nhiên ban tặng chúng ta thời tiết và các mùa tươi đẹp. Hãy học cách trân trọng chúng!
can_do: Wear suitable clothes for the weather.
Feel the wind on my face.
Listen to the sound of rain.
life_skill.value_question: What is one thing you can do to enjoy nature more?
life_skill.image_prompt: A diverse group of cheerful children, about 7 years old, engaged in respectful interaction with nature in different seasons. One child is watering a plant, another is looking at a butterfly, a third is listening to the rain under a leaf, and a fourth is observing autumn leaves. No text.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The sun is a star. It gives us light and warmth.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Mặt trời là một ngôi sao. Nó cho chúng ta ánh sáng và sự ấm áp.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Rain helps plants and trees grow.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Mưa giúp cây cối phát triển.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Some trees lose their leaves in autumn. This is called 'fall' in some places.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Một số cây rụng lá vào mùa thu. Ở một số nơi, mùa này còn được gọi là 'fall'.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Snowflakes have six sides. No two snowflakes are exactly alike!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Bông tuyết có sáu cạnh. Không có hai bông tuyết nào giống hệt nhau!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The wind helps kites fly high in the sky.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Gió giúp diều bay cao trên bầu trời.

classroom_game.name: Weather Charades
steps_en: Each group gets cards with weather words (sunny, rainy, windy, snowy, cloudy, hot, cold).
One student picks a card and acts out the weather without speaking.
Other students in the group guess the weather: 'Is it rainy?'
The first student to guess correctly gets a point.
Play continues until all cards are used.
steps_vi: Mỗi nhóm nhận các thẻ từ vựng thời tiết (nắng, mưa, gió, tuyết, mây, nóng, lạnh).
Một học sinh chọn một thẻ và diễn tả thời tiết đó mà không nói.
Các học sinh khác trong nhóm đoán thời tiết: 'Is it rainy?' (Trời có mưa không?)
Học sinh đoán đúng đầu tiên được một điểm.
Trò chơi tiếp tục cho đến khi hết thẻ.
